behaviors.behavior: SparTA implements a kernel template for block sparsity to support profiling block-size weights.
behaviors.precondition: Block-sparsity execution is to be profiled for weighted block cover.

evidence.quote: we implemented a kernel template for block sparsity

behaviors.behavior: Thirteen different block sizes are evaluated on the kernel template.
behaviors.precondition: The block-sparsity kernel template is available.

evidence.quote: evaluated 13 different block sizes on that template

behaviors.behavior: 在零稀疏配置下测量块稀疏 kernel 的延迟。
behaviors.precondition: kernel template 已按给定块大小配置，且稀疏度设为零。

evidence.quote: The overhead of each block size is proﬁled by measuring the latency of the kernel with zero sparsity

behaviors.behavior: 将测得的零稀疏延迟除以块数，得到该块大小的 overhead。
behaviors.precondition: 已完成零稀疏延迟测量，且已知该块大小对应的块数。

evidence.quote: dividing the latency with the number of blocks

behaviors.behavior: 将 profiling 得到的每块大小 overhead 用作该块大小的权重。
behaviors.precondition: 已按 O4 计算得到每块大小的 overhead。

evidence.quote: The overhead is used as the weight of the block sizes

behaviors.behavior: 将块大小权重供给执行计划变换中的 weighted block cover 算法使用。
behaviors.precondition: 每块大小权重已存在，且执行计划变换调用 weighted block cover。

evidence.quote: For the efﬁcient execution of weighted block cover in execution plan transformation (§3.3), SparTA calculates the weight of different block sizes

behaviors.behavior: 枚举所有块大小组合，分别运行 weighted block cover 算法。
behaviors.precondition: 算子过稀疏，无法饱和可用核心，导致 profiling 权重可能不准确。

evidence.quote: When an operator is too sparse to saturate available cores, the weights may become less accurate. In such cases, we enumerate all the combinations of block sizes to run the weighted block cover algorithm

behaviors.behavior: 从枚举得到的候选结果中选择最佳的一个。
behaviors.precondition: 枚举所有块大小组合并运行 weighted block cover 后产生了候选结果。

behaviors.behavior: 当算子过稀疏无法饱和可用核心时，将 profiling 得到的块大小权重视为可能不准确。
behaviors.precondition: 算子稀疏度高到可用核心未被饱和。

evidence.quote: When an operator is too sparse to saturate available cores, the weights may become less accurate

changes.reason: 将“零稀疏测延迟”和“除以块数”两个可独立证伪的动作合并为一条行为，应拆分以分别对应 O3 与 O4。
“用于 weighted block cover”在原文中由前一句“For the efficient execution of weighted block cover in execution plan transformation”支撑，但本行为引文只覆盖“overhead 用作权重”，未直接覆盖使用场景；建议补充引文或拆分使用关系。
该行为把“枚举所有组合运行 weighted block cover”和“选择最佳”两个可独立证伪的动作合并；且前置条件只写“权重可能不准确”，未明确“算子过稀疏无法饱和核心”这一触发条件。应拆分并补全前置条件。
